name: deciding-under-uncertainty
description: Hardens a recommendation on a consequential, hard-to-reverse call into a calibrated bet with a pre-agreed exit, instead of a single confident verdict. Use when advising or deciding: build vs buy, adopt or swap a dependency or platform, migrate now or wait, rewrite vs refactor, quit or double down, ship or delay - any "should we / should I" where being wrong is expensive to undo. Also for judging a past decision fairly. Not for generating design alternatives - the design-forking skill owns widening the option set; this skill disciplines the commitment once a leading option exists.
